notes.title: Steam Cloud saves are coming. This may affect your saved data!
notes.notes:
Greetings, pilots!
We're working on adding support for Steam Cloud saves.

This means that if you're playing on Windows, your savedata will be moved to:
%APPDATA%/ABJ69/savedata/[Your Steam ID]

These changes will be taking effect when we roll out the next build on Saturday.
You'll be able to copy and paste your savedata from the old folder to the new one after starting the game (running the new build) once.

Let us know if you run into any trouble. We'll be in the hangar!
